subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Package Theft
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Package Theft.

hook.text: 1.7 million packages are stolen from porches every day in the US. Porch piracy is a logistics nightmare.

buildup.text: Unattended package delivery creates a theft opportunity. The package sits until the customer returns.

discovery.text: Photo proof, smart locks, garage delivery, and secure lockers are all solutions to reduce theft.

twist.text: Replacing stolen packages costs retailers $25+ billion a year in the US alone. Somebody pays.

climax.text: Amazon Key and Walmart InHome deliver inside the house or garage—eliminating the porch entirely.

punchline.text: If the porch isn't safe, deliver somewhere else.

quiz.question: How many packages are stolen daily in the US?
